title: Proposals ship as docs-only pull requests
summary: With **Docs auto-merge** on, **Draft artifacts** now works on its own branch `docs/<change>` and asks the agent to open the proposal as a pull request of its own, which merges like any other docs-only one; the card labels it **Proposal**. **Implement** starts beside it on `feat/<change>`, from the proposal while that is still open.
